reason: A is the better proposal because dilute Ti substitution and possible grain-boundary cohesion modification are more physically plausible in BCC NbMoTaW and are directly testable, although Ti segregation and retention of high-temperature/irradiation performance remain unsupported assumptions. B improperly extrapolates carbon-induced FCC-to-HCP TWIP/TRIP evidence to a stable BCC refractory alloy, where strong carbide formation is more likely than the proposed transformation mechanism.
